basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas, dabbling in the world of SPACs and finance as a side hobby. My main interests include technology, investing, and anime. When I'm not coding or exploring new investment opportunities, I enjoy gaming and watching anime. Typically online during evenings and weekends. In a long-term relationship with my girlfriend, who shares my interest in technology and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working in the tech industry for the past 5 years. My interest in SPACs started a few months ago after a friend introduced me to the concept. Since then, I've been learning through online forums, articles, and discussions on Reddit.
